question: Rivet's stride length. Seen from above, his torso and arms hide his legs: at the day stride a foot reaches only 0.53 m (walk) / 0.73 m (run) from his centre, inside his ~0.84 m half-footprint, so walking, strafing and running barely read at 32 px/m. A longer stride shows the legs but slows the cadence (the feet stay planted, no skating). In each clip the LEFT Rivet is today's stride 1.0.

options.label: Stride 1.3 (0.68 / 0.92 m)
options.tradeoff: legs show at a run, cadence still quick

options.label: Stride 1.6 (0.83 / 1.12 m)
options.tradeoff: legs read clearly, the gait looks loping and heavy
